title: Since I installed last nights version, I no longer get data on my watch.
symptom: After updating xDrip+ to a newer nightly, the user no longer gets xDrip notifications / glucose readings on their Gear 2 watch via the Notification feature, although readings still appear on the phone.
cause: The thread identifies a regression in xDrip nightly versions: the Android Notifications function was broken after the 7/15/18 version, and bisection showed the 8/9/18 nightly was the first broken version.
fix: The reporter's workaround is to reinstall the xDrip+ 7/15/18 version, which restores notifications to the watch; versions from 8/9/18 onward remained broken. Another user fixed a similar issue by uninstalling xDrip from the watch, resyncing apps, and reinstalling it.
evidence_quote: Reinstalled the 7/15 version yet again, and data is now being sent to my watch again. So, sometime after that version,Android Notifications function got broken.   PLEASE FIX.
